QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] Taming the Flame 1
QuestInfo.0: According to Rino, the only safe way through the Extinction Zone is on the back of a Flame Bird. Taming one, however, will take a little work...
QuestInfo.1: You agree to gather 10 Solid Claws. Apparently the Flame Bird finds them delicious. You can obtain the Solid Claw from Stone Erdas that live in the Rock Zone and Fire Rock Zone.
QuestInfo.2: You collected Solid Claws from the Stone Erdas and gave them to Rino.

0.0: So you want to ride a Flame Bird! Well, if you don't want it to peck your eyes out, first you will need Solid Claws from Stone Erdas, the Flame Bird's favorite snack. You'll need about #b40 of them#k. They're hungry beasts.

yes.0: You can find Stone Erdas in the Rock Zone and Fire Rock Zone. Come to me after you've collected #b40 Solid Claws#k.

no.0: I understand if you need time to prepare yourself for the task.

1.0: You brought the Solid Claws! Excellent,  I'll hold on to them for you.
1.1: The next thing you'll need is some #bSticky Oil#k from Blazing Erdas. You slather it on the back of the Flame Bird so you don't fall off. It has the added benefit of being fire-retardant. Let me know when you're ready to proceed to the next step.

default.0: Gather Solid Claws from Stone Erdas. It's the Flame Bird's favorite food!
